label: preparing
what: A large jubilee or hospitality gathering in the great hall, apparently timed for the mayor's 18:00 lighting inspection. Baker and freight are producing and delivering two hundred jubilee loaves, while the innkeeper coordinates hall storage and claims the commission and payment. The actual celebration and purpose have not been disclosed; the lighting inspection appears to provide the occasion to bring the mayor there. Secretary knowingly coordinates the appointment and builder the lighting inspection, though their knowledge of the undisclosed celebration is uncertain.
